# talon

> `talon` is a standalone, lightweight agent execution engine and role-shell runtime developed for the Sovereign Raptor fleet.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/talon && cd talon && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install -q pytest pyte && make test` (expect: All Talon release tests PASSED.).
Licence: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 OR PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (free trial for evaluation).
